# R1. BYZ / ROM / TUR: deter distant non-neighboring exclaves before stabilizing Aegean-Anatolian heartland
oe_ai2_byz_tur_anti_far_exclave = {
	attacker_potential = {
		oe_ai2_ai_base = yes
		OR = {
			tag = BYZ
			tag = ROM
			tag = TUR
		}
		current_year < 1550
	}
	target_trigger = {
		NOT = { is_neighbor_of = scope:attacker }
		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				region = region:north_german_region
				region = region:south_german_region
				region = region:france_region
				region = region:iberia_region
				region = region:khorasan_region
				region = region:maghreb_region
				region = region:baltic_region
				region = region:russian_region
			}
		}
	}
	multiplier = {
		add = -0.75
	}
	score = {
		add = -300
	}
}
